independent_vintf_review.review_scope: Read-only review of final validation evidence and pinned releasetools; no rebuild or source changes.
independent_vintf_review.conclusion: VINTF compatibility and kernel configuration checks were not skipped.

evidence.entrypoint: CLI main calls CheckVintf directly; it does not call CheckVintfIfTrebleEnabled or use that wrapper skip_compatibility_check branch.
evidence.invocation: build-source.py invokes host check_target_files_vintf with final target-files path and subprocess.run(check=True); validators_passed is set only after all validators and packaged policy analysis complete.
evidence.logging: Pinned common.InitLogging uses WARNING by default; compatible command results are INFO. Warning-only log with exit 0 is expected successful behavior.
evidence.failure_handling: Any incompatible SKU sets success=False and CLI exits 1; checkvintf execution errors raise. SKU defaults prevent an empty validation loop.
evidence.warnings: SYSTEM/VENDOR etc/build.prop probes fall back to root build.prop; absent separate ODM build.prop is expected. The VINTF unzip subset excludes IMAGES/boot.img and IMAGES/init_boot.img, causing optional LoadInfoDict probes to warn; those warnings do not skip compatibility checks.
evidence.kernel_branch: Both META files exist, so GetArgsForKernel passes --kernel version_path:config_path to checkvintf for both SKU combinations.
